2026-03-21T18:05:02Z stream session=a1 recv token-count=250

Elena: looks like non-jittered client backoff + upstream GC spike.

Nina: I'll add a composite alert: partial_chunk_rate > 0.3% AND reconnect_rate +10% in 5m.

InfraBot: Created ticket INC-4412 and linked follow-ups: https://tracker/redwood/INC-4412
Elena: I'll add telemetry event when SDK detects mid-stream partial and tag sessions so SRE can correlate quickly.

Nina: owner rotation: Week1 Ops (Raj), Week2 SRE (Sven), then ProdEng review (Nina/Elena). recurring calendar invite created.
